name: Product Advisory Council
seoTitle: Product Advisory Council: 18 perspectives for AI decisions
seoDescription: Explore 18 AI analytical perspectives through 72 example Q&As and selected method pages. The complete installable skill contains 255 method cards.
ledeOne: An AI skill for thinking through product decisions.
ledeTwo: What to build, for whom, and why? Explore it from different angles.
meetTitle: Whose perspective will you explore first?
meetHint: Choose an avatar · 4 Q&As each · 72 selected methods
disclosure: These are AI analysis examples based on public method cards, not replies or endorsements by the people shown. Avatars are illustrations.
sendAgent: Then send it to your Agent
installIntro: Please install the Product Advisory Council skill so I can use its analytical perspectives in this Agent.
installBody: First read the repository README and installation instructions. Identify the current client and its supported skill installation method, then install the entire product-advisory-council folder, not just SKILL.md. Back up an existing version before updating.
installVerify: After installation, verify file completeness and client discovery. Explain how to start and whether a new session is needed. If direct installation is unavailable, explain why and provide minimal manual steps for this client. Do not claim success without verification.
noScript: All perspectives are shown below. Avatar links jump to the corresponding Q&As.
exampleNote: This site presents 72 selected methods; the complete skill contains 255. Examples illustrate an approach, not answers from the people shown. A real review uses your users, evidence and constraints.
howTitle: Bring the discussion to your real problem.
howHint: Use one perspective or convene a council.
step1Body: Name the user, current alternatives, known facts, resources, and deadline. Unknowns can remain unknown.
step2Body: Choose one advisor or form a council for the question. Compare assumptions, alternatives, and counterexamples instead of counting votes.
step3Body: Get conditional recommendations and a small experiment. Generate a discussion page and export it as images or PDF.
installDescription1: Download the full package and import it into a skill-capable AI client.
installDescription2: Install once for 18 perspectives. Invite only those your question needs.
packageNote: Keep the complete product-advisory-council folder. No model or API key is included.
examplePrompt: Use Product Advisory Council at medium depth: I want to build an AI note-taking tool, but many competitors exist. Identify the key differentiation hypothesis and design an experiment I can run in two weeks.
promptTip: After installation, send this to your AI assistant.
